## Release checklist (all must be ticked)
- [ ] `VERSION` bumped (for example 12.1 → 12.2)
- [ ] First line of `SKILL.md` shows the same version, and the "Using DHAP GBP vN." line matches
- [ ] New entry at the TOP of `CHANGELOG.md` (version · date · what changed · who asked)
- [ ] No internal identifiers, passwords, tokens or customer data added (use the {{KB_ID}} / {{LOCATION_ID}} placeholders)
- [ ] Templates updated if the page code changed
- [ ] The "validate" check is green
- [ ] After merge: every user's Ask AI loader still reports the new version
